## What the update is about, in words.
##
## Written by hand on 2026-11-03 from the official patch notes of the release
## (hub.realmofthemadgod.com/news0/updates0/s312pn), then checked against
## the client of the same day (build 730b86d6). No amount of reading the client
## tells you why anything was added. Everything else on the What's New page is
## generated by comparing two clients; this file is the one part of it that is
## editorial, and it is dated and signed for exactly that reason.
##
## Where the notes and the client disagree, the client's names are used and
## the disagreement is said in the text: the notes call the Druid ST pieces by
## the names of Kogbold Steamworks enemies, and the realm's Primal Snake skin
## is the Silver one in the client.
##
## Format: see motmg-season31-part1.txt.

title|White Snake Invasion
subtitle|Season 31, Part 2
date|2026-11-03
lede|The Ocean Trench is rebuilt from the sea floor up, with a new Thessal fight and three new rewards. The White Snake comes back for four weeks of featured dungeons, Divine Coins and a solo leaderboard; six Shinies, a Druid ST set and a long list of fixes come with it.

place|Ocean Trench Portal|Thessal the Mermaid Goddess, in a fight rebuilt in phases around her coral bombs, her deep-sea beasts, her coral bow and her siren song. On the way: several kinds of slurps, Hermit God minions, new fishmen and coral turrets.|The Squidver, the Coral Juice Refinery, the Fire Coral Branch and the Coral set

part|The Ocean Trench, reworked
blurb|New art, new music, new enemies, and Thessal fought in phases.
show|places
point|The rework comes from the Craig's Builders program: led by CaptainDagaz, with sprites by Sheepsmall and DynamoX and music by ENNWAY. The trench is now one of the most decorated dungeons in the game — plants, rocks, coral, critters, and the ruins of an older society beside the fishmen's.
point|Every existing enemy has new attacks. Thessal keeps the feel of her old fight with more phases and more variety.
show|things|Squidver::reskins the Huntsman's Volley;Coral Juice Refinery::a reusable Coral Juice, every 15 seconds;Fire Coral Branch::the new artifact
point|The Squidver is the Huntsman's Volley with the trench's look: the client gives both the same shot, mana cost and speed bonus. The Fire Coral Branch weighs Wisdom and Mana enchantments seven times heavier and the Coral Volley awakened fifteen times — though the client's pool names that enchantment AWAKENED_CORAL_BOW, which no enchantment carries, so the calculator cannot apply the last part.
show|things|Coral Bow;Coral Venom Trap;Coral Silk Armor;Coral Ring
point|The Coral set and its Shinies have new sprites. The client also declares a Legacy copy of each piece, each with its Shiny, and a Legacy Ocean Trench Portal; the notes say nothing of them.
show|things|Miss Cancan;Pearl-Adorned Seahorse;Glowlamp Nautilus;Siren Call Entrance::player entrance;Last Breath Thessal::skin
point|Three sea pets, a Thessal skin and an entrance arrive in the client with the rework, also unmentioned.

part|Return of the White Snake
blurb|Defeated at a Lunar New Year, healed, and back.
show|things|The White Snake::the Serpent itself
point|Clear the featured dungeons and hunt snakes to open the White Snake's temples, then face the Serpent itself.
show|checks|Every invasion dungeon has a 60% chance to drop a portal to the next tier, as Stromwell's Rift does;;White Snake II has a 50% chance of a random exalt; White Snake III a 50% chance each at up to two;;The White Snake's larger attacks have hitboxes 25% smaller;;Many drop rates are higher, the Eden's Embrace's much higher, and it always drops Rare or better;;White Snake III drops dust;;White Snake Invasion I no longer opens several realm portals when it is done;;The Primal Snake of White Snake Invasion II is down to 80,000 health and has a boss health bar
point|Three Steam achievements go with the three dungeons: Ssspiritual Pesst Control, Temple Exorcissst, and The White Snake Has Retreated.

part|White Snake rewards
blurb|A ring, two snakes and a chest of old favourites.
show|things|Eden's Embrace::White Snake Invasion III, solo or not;Silver Primal Snake Pet Skin::from Primal Snakes in the realm;Gold Primal Snake Pet Skin::the rare one
point|The notes call the first skin plain "Primal Snake Pet Skin"; the client's is the Silver one.
show|things|Legend of the White Snake Mystery Chest
point|The chest drops from Spirit Snakes (very rarely), missions, the three invasions, Primal Snakes and the Tinkerer. It holds one of:
show|list|In the chest|Pecan Pie; Mystery Stat Pot; Agents of Oryx Shard x15; Medium Dust Chest; Superior Sulphur; Coral Bow; Coral Venom Trap; Coral Silk Armor; Coral Ring; Hivemind Mace; Blue Bee Armor; Red Bee Armor; Yellow Bee Armor; Queen's Stinger Dagger; Hivemaster Helm; Beekeeper's Flamethrower; Combcutter Kunai; Pirate King's Cutlass; Wavecrest Concertina; Sword of the Colossus; Marble Seal; Breastplate of New Life; Magical Lodestone; Leaf Bow; Wakizashi of Eastern Winds; Labyrinth Dweller's Sheath; Elder Staff; Flowering Kimono; Sage's Wakibiki; Ethereal Happi; Elegant Parasol; Rain Maker; Taiko Drums; Recurring Terror Spell; Scepter of Devastation; Tome of Pain; Maw of Malignance; The Forgotten Crown; Noble Mandolin; Warmonger; Peacekeeper; The Twilight Gemstone; Polarity Poison; Dusky Catalyst; Primal Arcana; Royal Guard's Cuirass; Mantle of the Monarchy; Vest of Abandoned Shadows; Bracer of the Guardian; Vanguard's Visage; Sentinel's Sidearm; Valor
show|things|Divine Coin x1::from event chests, missions, and White Snake III as a Crucible character;Divine Snake Oil::from Spirit Snake swarms and the Battle Pass
show|things|Comfy Beach Snake (emote);Freaky Stheno (emote);Confused White Snake (emote);Drooling White Snake (emote);Thinking White Snake (emote);Bonked White Snake (emote)

part|The Altar and the way in
blurb|How to reach each invasion.
show|things|Altar of the White Snake::once per realm, in the Carboniferous biome
point|Once found, the Altar's place stays revealed in every later realm. Ten Divine Coins there open a portal to White Snake Invasion III.
show|steps|Invasion I — guaranteed after a featured dungeon of difficulty 5 or more;;Invasion II — guaranteed after difficulty 7 or more, or from the Primal Snakes near the Altar;;Invasion III — guaranteed after a featured dungeon of difficulty 8.5, or ten Divine Coins at the Altar

part|Featured dungeons
blurb|Four weeks, one Adept and one Veteran dungeon each.
show|week|Week 1|Ocean Trench::1.5× loot and XP::|The Nest::1.5× loot and XP::
show|week|Week 2|Deadwater Docks::1.5× loot and XP::|Lost Halls::1.5× loot and XP::
show|week|Week 3|Woodland Labyrinth::1.5× loot and XP::|Moonlight Village::1.5× loot and XP::
show|week|Week 4|Parasite Chambers::1.5× loot and XP::|The Shatters::1.5× loot and XP::
point|Each featured boss leaves an event chest with a chance at Divine Coins, then two portals to any White Snake Invasion.
show|list|Divine Tokens per run|Difficulty 5+: 1, and 25% for a second; Difficulty 7+: 1, and 50% for a second; Difficulty 8.5+: 2, and 50% for a third

part|Solo leaderboard and the Tinkerer
blurb|Divine Coins, traded at the Tinkerer.
point|Only Solo White Snake Invasion III counts for the season's leaderboard, which weighs both your participation and your seasonal character. Its key costs ten Divine Coins at the Tinkerer, once a day. The rewards — the Golden Primal Snake Pet Skin, the blue title "the Snake Charmer" and a new character skin — arrive when the next season starts.
show|things|Solo White Snake Invasion III Key
show|list|At the Tinkerer|10 Divine Coins: Solo White Snake Invasion Key, once a day; 30 Divine Coins: Legend of the White Snake Mystery Chest, once a day; 30 Divine Coins: a Quest Chest of your choice, once a day; 50 Divine Coins: a new emote, three of them, once per account each

part|Battle Pass and Celestial Stones
blurb|Fangs and reptiles, and a dancer for a hundred stones.
show|skins|Cursed Paladin::a very dark Paladin;Snake Flower Kensei::covered in flowers
point|The Battle Pass carries snake items at every milestone; only its Exalt tiers give Celestial Stones.
show|skins|Snake Dancer Mystic::100 Celestial Stones, at the Tinkerer
point|Stones come from the shop and the Battle Pass; the Tinkerer is in the Daily Quest Rooms off the Nexus. A new branch joins the mission tree, and either faction's missions advance the Community Contest.
show|skins|Tiramisu King Knight;Mollusk Wizard
point|The client carries these two skins as well; the notes do not say where they come from.

part|Shinies
blurb|Six more, for seasonal characters.
show|things|Shifting Shroud::Shiny;Kageboshi::Shiny;Morning Square::Shiny;The Triangle::Shiny;Esben's Wedding Ring::Shiny;Magical Lodestone::Shiny

part|Mechanical Raptor Druid Set
blurb|The Druid's ST set, from the Kogbold Steamworks.
show|set|Mechanical Raptor Druid Set
point|It drops in the Kogbold Steamworks; the Advanced Steamworks drops its pieces with one enchantment slot or more. The notes name the pieces after Steamworks enemies — Factory Control Core, Kogbold Flying Machine, Kogbold Battlesmith, Kogbold Steamwalker; the client's are the four above.

part|Quality of life
blurb|What changes in the game's own screens.
show|checks|A new Crucible screen: two columns, boosts, debuffs and restrictions by colour, details on hover;;A new Wardrobe title screen: Full and Modular tabs, progress shown as current/goal, unobtainable titles hidden;;Party leaders choose whether members may invite (off by default);;Private notes on friends, up to 100 characters, shown on hover;;Holding the interaction key over a player shows their core attributes;;The graveyard draws each dead character in black and white, with skin, dyes and accessories;;Storage grouped by type is sorted alphabetically inside each group;;A Claim All button for mission rewards, pausing on choices;;The mission tree remembers Graph or List view;;A setting for the height of the minimized chat;;A setting to always show items above loot bags (off by default);;Borderless windowed display;;A slider for the camera's off-centre shift;;The vault chest turns green when the vault is seasonal

part|Fixes
blurb|What the release repaired.
show|checks|Earthen Bulwark summons no longer disconnect when lasers hit them in the Advanced Kogbold Steamworks;;Pet eggs no longer vanish when used while holding the interact key;;Tooltips scroll while a trade is open;;The Neo Blazon Bow's tooltip gives the right bleed damage;;Exaltation slots list every dungeon that applies;;The Tome of Holy Guidance's tooltip says its damage pierces armour;;The Magic Woods credits highlight their headings;;Summoner summons spawn more evenly around the cursor while moving;;Item tooltips show decimals, not only enchantment descriptions;;Boss bars show 1M rather than 1000K;;The Enchant button stays active with too little gold for dust;;Consumables in the pet bag work with the pet far away;;Dalvar's Battle Axe shots no longer turn back after a Bard buff;;Moonlight Village's spotlight appears with its modifier;;The Legion Elite Skull shows one health bonus, +90;;The Enchanter's map icon is back;;The Prism of Phantoms (T5) no longer looks bleached with equipment glow on;;Ctrl-clicking a server message opens no player menu;;Craig's Gift shows the right gold value in the Nexus;;Long dungeon names no longer overlap the player list;;Slaughterer completes at 10,000 beach kills, The Adversary at 1,000;;The invincible icon and health bar ignore opacity;;Beam damage counts Crucible damage;;Big Berdtha has the right collection and craft icons;;The Nest's encounter counts as a Veteran encounter in missions;;Orbs affect every enemy;;The Battle Pass title no longer overlaps its timer;;The Forge shows and gives the right rarity for low-tier dungeon UTs;;Seal tooltips show their full effect with another seal worn;;Potions can no longer be drunk twice from the rack;;The Superior Masks of Anubis, Cnidaria, Lightning and Mucus are soulbound;;The Legion Elite Trap has a different effect;;Tidal Wave Kensei ST shows its generation icon;;Dungeon music is as loud as the realm's;;The Dragon's Treasure quest waits for level 20;;Retainer's Battlesuit drops from the three minor creepy dark manifestations in the Ice Citadel;;The Cavalry Lance needs a full dash;;The Crystal Shield's retaliation shot scales with Defense, and its bonus damage with enchantments and the Crucible;;Effect icons sit right on skins with idle animations;;The launcher's blog link and update button work again;;Items stack from any loot bag slot;;Daily quests paid from the pet inventory no longer disconnect;;The potion vault's Max button counts in one click;;Campaign points show on every shop item;;The Killer Bee's health scales with nearby players;;Several enchantment typos are fixed;;Sunken Treasure and Jewel Anglers spawn in the Deep Sea Abyss;;The UFO spawns with players standing on its spot;;Neo Reality and Neo Entropy Reactors trigger Dark Matter and Power;;The Neo Reality Reactor restores 200 health and 100 magic below 300 health;;Golden Sphinx Mk II is named right in Neo Katalund death messages;;Swapping two full Druid sigils and transforming uses the right ability;;Mad Lab turrets show when they are about to fire;;Unique enchantments take the Tarot Cards' multipliers in the Enchanter
point|A few of these can be read in the client. The Legion Elite Skull's +90 health and the four masks' soulbinding are in the item data, and the enchantment typos are fixed in the ids too — Vampiric Lifeforce, Overwhelming Strikes, the two Thanksgiving enchantments. The Tarot change is the one that moves the calculator: the cards' ×4.5 on a stat now reaches the unique enchantment of that stat, and its own bonus drops from ×15 to ×3.33.
